title: Report or evidence?
teacher: Crew Docs — keeps the records. Explains, shows, then reads your attempt. Coaches; never grades.
objective: Separate an AI's report from evidence of what actually happened: for each claim, say whether it is evidenced, only claimed, or contradicted, and state one honest limit.
explain: A report is a sentence somebody wrote. Evidence is something you can open and check without asking them.
When an agent says it finished, it is telling you what it believes. That may be true. Your job is to find out which parts you can see for yourself.
For every claim, look for a record with a time and its zone, a named source, and an artifact you can open, ideally with a hash so you know it is the same file. Then sort the claim:
And always say what your evidence does not prove. That line is the one people forget.

labels.Only claimed: Only the report says so. A missing record is a gap, not a “no”.
labels.Contradicted: An explicit record of the same scope (same target, same time) shows something incompatible.

worked_example.agent_report: Done, deployed and tested. The login timeout is fixed in production and all checks pass.
evidence: Observed 2026-XX-XX 14:05 America/Chicago (UTC-6) Source repository history (read-only) Artifact commit 4e1c… "raise session timeout to 30 min" + diff SHA-256 9f2a…c41e (placeholder)
Source deploy log, inspected window: last 24 h (completeness not known) Artifact no deploy entry found in that window after 2026-XX-XX 09:12
Source test runner Artifact none attached Not supplied behavioural test of rev 4e1c… in production

sorted.claim: The timeout-related code change was committed.
sorted.label: Evidenced
sorted.why: Commit 4e1c… and its diff are in the repository history.

sorted.label: Only claimed
sorted.why: Not established: code changed, behaviour unshown. Needed: a behavioural test of rev 4e1c… in the named environment, with output, time and zone.

sorted.label: Only claimed
sorted.why: Not established. No entry in the inspected 24 h window is a gap, not a “no”.

worked_example.limit: The commit proves a timeout-related change was committed. It does not prove the fix works, that it reached production, or that any checks ran.

exercise.instructions: Choose a label for each claim, name the artifact and explain your reason. Then add one honest limit. This page does not mark your answers.
exercise.answer_format: Free text, or JSON {"claims":[{"label","reason"} x3],"limit"}. Max 32768 UTF-8 bytes.
